tracks.title: 最後一題
tracks.subject: A Wednesday-night host of a small local TV quiz in a Tseung Kwan O studio flips over the final-round card and finds it blank, so he asks the first thing in his head, whether the contestant has eaten yet, and a 70-year-old grandmother buzzes first and wins the restaurant voucher.

tracks.title: 吹哨輝叔
tracks.subject: A 68-year-old retired storeroom clerk, Uncle Fai, gets new dentures that whistle on every four and every ten he says, so his wife can hear him coming from two streets away and finally catches him sneaking barbecue pork buns.

tracks.title: 畢業冊後頁
tracks.subject: A man pulls out his 1999 school yearbook after twenty-five years, finds a pencilled phone number on the back page that says call me after the exams, and dials it; the voice that answers says she had been wondering when he would look.

tracks.title: 十二樓B座
tracks.subject: A flower shop delivery woman rings flat 12B every Friday for a bouquet meant for 12D, and the lonely man in 12B, who has never received flowers, keeps taking them without correcting her until he leaves a thank-you note.

tracks.title: 一隻玻璃碟
tracks.subject: A woman finally returns a glass casserole dish with her friend's name on masking tape on the bottom, borrowed nineteen years ago when soup was brought after her baby was born, and stands holding it outside her friend's old door.

tracks.title: 一炮三響
tracks.subject: At four siblings' monthly mahjong night round Big Sister's Sha Tin dining table, played for who buys the milk tea, she takes five minutes over every discard while the others doze, until she finally throws a five-dot and all three win on it at once.

tracks.title: 求其填
tracks.subject: A 48-year-old clerk in a Sheung Wan shipping office fills in the morning paper's Sudoku in ball-pen before the pantry kettle boils, and the whole floor thinks he is a genius, though he just writes any numbers because nobody ever checks; when the tea lady spots three sevens in one row he confesses to everyone, and nobody believes him: so clever, they say, and modest too.

tracks.title: 你嗰半有我
tracks.subject: Before her boyfriend leaves for a two-year posting in Toronto, a woman breaks their finished 1,000-piece world-map jigsaw down the middle; he takes the half with Hong Kong, she keeps the half with Toronto, and he carries his home rebuilt in a pizza box.

tracks.title: 搖搖板
tracks.mood: flirty, teasing, rocking sway, playful payback
tracks.subject: Two childhood playmates meet at thirty-five by their Wong Tai Sin estate seesaw: at seven she was the heavy one who kept him dangling until he said please; now he outweighs her, she hangs in the air, and his 'please' is asking her to dinner.

tracks.title: 阿爺玩滑梯
tracks.subject: A 71-year-old raised in a hillside squatter hut with no playground rides the long slide in Tuen Mun Park for the first time because his four-year-old granddaughter won't go alone, then climbs back up by himself while she waits below to catch him.

tracks.title: 摺牆床
tracks.subject: a man in a 160-square-foot Tai Kok Tsui flat whose fold-down wall bed has a stuck spring, so every night at midnight he has to wrestle it down like a dance partner, and every morning it springs back up and traps his work shirt

tracks.title: 三十支豉油
tracks.subject: a woman who buys thirty bottles of soy sauce on a supermarket half-price day and then has nowhere in her tiny flat to put them, so they end up under the bed, in the shoe cabinet and lined along the bathtub

tracks.title: 見光就乞嚏
tracks.subject: a woman in a windowless Sham Shui Po subdivided flat who sneezes three times every morning the moment she steps out of the dark stairwell into sunlight, while the herbal-tea shop owner downstairs counts them, and three rainy days without a sneeze leave her feeling she has not woken up

tracks.title: 凌晨四點十七
tracks.subject: a woman who is woken at exactly 4:17 every night by a calf cramp and has to stand barefoot on the cold kitchen tiles of her tiny flat, flexing her toes and counting the trucks on the flyover until the knot lets go

tracks.title: 十二圈
tracks.subject: a woman who buys her boyfriend a loud brass twin-bell wind-up alarm clock from a Sham Shui Po second-hand shop because he never wakes on time, and every night before she goes home she winds it exactly twelve turns at his bedside, until one night he winds it for her

tracks.title: 關公跌咗
tracks.subject: a red minibus driver whose little plastic Guan Yu figure falls off the dashboard on a corner, and he pulls over and refuses to move until the passengers find it under the seats

tracks.title: 千蚊紙冇人找
tracks.subject: a man who finds an old orange thousand-dollar note in a winter coat pocket and spends a whole day failing to get any shop to break it for a bun and a drink

tracks.title: 落枕
tracks.subject: a woman who wakes up with a cricked neck and can only turn her whole body, so all day her boss, her crush and a bus driver think she is snubbing them

tracks.title: 單底寫兩隻字
tracks.subject: a cha chaan teng cook who for twenty years has slipped a two-word note under each order slip he passes to his wife at the cashier counter

tracks.title: 最後一程搖搖馬
tracks.subject: residents of a public housing estate queueing on its last evening to take one final ride on the old spring rocking horse before the playground is rebuilt

tracks.title: 餃子爆晒
tracks.subject: a man in his Sha Tin flat at 2 a.m. folding fifty pork dumplings for a friends' bring-a-dish dinner, every one bursting in the pot, so he brings the pot as 'dumpling soup'

tracks.title: 鼻鼾錄音
tracks.mood: warm, lazy, tender, quietly certain love
tracks.subject: a woman in a Kwun Tong flat who secretly records four minutes of her boyfriend's snoring, then plays it on his pillow to fall asleep while he is away on a work trip

tracks.title: 跟住前面嗰架
tracks.subject: a woman after work on the upper-deck front seat of a Hong Kong tram crawling behind another slow tram along Des Voeux Road, trading faces with a kid in the tram ahead and deciding she is in no hurry

tracks.title: 三毫子
tracks.subject: six friends after a Mong Kok hotpot splitting a HK$1,320 bill to the ten-cent coin on a calculator, stuck on thirty cents nobody will own, until the friend running the sums pays it himself

tracks.title: 挺直
tracks.subject: a man whose physiotherapist tells him to stop slouching at his desk, and his wife who taps him between the shoulder blades every time he hunches, at dinner, on the MTR, in front of the TV, until he starts slouching on purpose just to get the tap

tracks.title: 八達通餘額
tracks.subject: a young man who notices his Octopus card balance never drops below fifty dollars and slowly realises his girlfriend has been secretly topping it up at the 7-Eleven every week

tracks.title: 紙皮箱貓
tracks.subject: a man who spends eight hundred dollars on a fancy padded cat bed, and his cat ignores it to sleep in the cardboard box it was delivered in

tracks.title: 兩點紅豆沙
tracks.subject: two flatmates who cannot sleep making red bean soup at two in the morning in a tiny Sham Shui Po kitchen, dancing around the pot while it simmers

tracks.title: 花墟細盆栽
tracks.subject: a clumsy office clerk who buys his first tiny juniper bonsai at the Mong Kok Flower Market, names it Ah Keung, and reports his day to it every evening while trying not to kill it

tracks.title: 儲印花
tracks.subject: a ten-year-old girl in Tai Po trying to collect forty supermarket stamps for a tiny ceramic kitchen-set figure before the promotion ends on Sunday, drafting every adult she knows into buying milk

tracks.title: 貼紙樽
tracks.subject: a woman staying over at her boyfriend's flat who writes masking-tape labels for every unmarked jar in his kitchen, and he keeps them all even the wrong ones

tracks.title: 張單冇咗字
tracks.mood: frantic, cheeky, laughing at bad luck
tracks.subject: a man trying to return a broken desk fan to a Wan Chai electrical shop with a thermal-paper receipt that has faded completely blank

tracks.title: 浮唔起
tracks.subject: a forty-two-year-old woman in an adult beginners' swimming class at a Kowloon public pool who cannot float without her kickboard, until the coach quietly lets go

tracks.title: 金魚第三年
tracks.subject: a ten-dollar goldfish won for a girlfriend's niece that nobody wanted, now three years old in its third bigger tank in a Tai Kok Tsui flat

tracks.title: 三十二隻白
tracks.subject: a couple choosing a wall colour for their first 300-square-foot flat from thirty-two almost identical white paint chips at a Mong Kok hardware shop

tracks.title: 張大口
tracks.mood: cheeky, flustered and laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a man at a dental scaling whose hygienist keeps asking him chatty questions while his mouth is propped open, so every answer comes out as 'ah' and she guesses wrong each time

tracks.title: 排到天光
tracks.subject: a man queuing at 6am outside a famous Hong Kong bakery for the fresh egg tarts his sleeping girlfriend wants, befriending an old regular with a stool, a woman doing her make-up and a paid queue-sitter

tracks.title: 同一盞燈
tracks.subject: two strangers who each bought the same old brass desk lamp at a Sham Shui Po flea-market stall meet when both come back for the one matching shade, and agree to share it

tracks.title: 皮鞋上獅子山
tracks.subject: a man who loses a bet to his friend and must hike up Lion Rock in brand-new leather office shoes, blistering, slipping and overtaken by grannies, then walking down barefoot

tracks.title: 一定係二
tracks.subject: a woman getting her first pair of glasses at thirty-one after an optician's 'one or two' lens test, walking out to find bus-stop signs, single tree leaves, and her partner waving from across the crossing suddenly sharp

tracks.title: 唔該唔好掂
tracks.subject: a gallery attendant at the Hong Kong Museum of History who spends her whole shift telling visitors not to touch the red-sail fishing junk and the old tram, a schoolboy who climbs in and rings the tram bell, and her own secret tap on the junk's glass case after closing

tracks.title: 三點四十五
tracks.subject: a married couple who both work non-teaching jobs at the same secondary school, the lab technician and the librarian, meeting every day at 3:45 after the bell to split one cold bottle of Vitasoy in the empty science prep room, six years on

tracks.title: 七點半校門口
tracks.subject: a young woman whose older sister paid her HK$8,000 school fees and would not take an IOU; with no money to repay, she walks her six-year-old niece to school at 7:30 every weekday for a year, ticking each trip on a fridge calendar, and when she finally brings the HK$8,000 the sister pushes it back and says the school runs aren't finished

tracks.title: 邊個又郁咗
tracks.subject: a man who spends a Sunday putting the family's living-room TV channels in a sensible order, then wages a running war with his mum, little sister, grandpa and dad, who keep scrambling it, until a family vote puts the Korean drama channel first

tracks.title: 數錯湯圓
tracks.subject: an old man in Tsuen Wan who, every winter solstice eve, hand-rolls black-sesame tong yuen, two each, for his three grown children's households and grandkids coming for dinner, keeps miscounting, ends up three over, then needs four more when his son brings his girlfriend's mother and his son-in-law wants four, and gives his own bowl to his grandson

tracks.title: 幫你影多張
tracks.mood: cocky, put-upon and grinning, a boyfriend playing the martyr for laughs
tracks.subject: a boyfriend stuck shooting two hundred photos of his girlfriend in front of a Sheung Wan mural, crouching, climbing a bollard, blocking tourists, until she picks the very first one

tracks.title: 得返三蚊
tracks.mood: tipsy, giddy and broke, laughing at a two a.m. problem
tracks.subject: leaving a Lan Kwai Fong club at 1:40 a.m. with three dollars left on her Octopus card, missing the last train by a minute and walking to the Central minibus stand with friends

tracks.title: 天台啲竹
tracks.mood: sunny, petty and amused, a neighbourhood feud that is half a friendship
tracks.subject: a young tenant and the auntie from the fifth floor fighting a quiet war over bamboo drying poles on the roof of a Yau Ma Tei walk-up, moving each other's shirts every morning

tracks.title: 又跳掣
tracks.mood: sweaty, wry and loyal, four friends laughing between flights of stairs
tracks.subject: four friends cooking hotpot in a tiny subdivided flat in Sham Shui Po in August, the breaker tripping every time the air-con and the induction cooker run together

tracks.title: 包雲吞
tracks.mood: tender, unhurried and quietly amused, a Sunday at home
tracks.subject: teaching her boyfriend to fold wontons at the folding table of their small flat on a Sunday afternoon, every one of his falling apart in the pot

tracks.title: 按住講
tracks.mood: cheeky, rambling and very pleased with himself
tracks.subject: a retired grandfather who has just discovered hold-to-talk voice messages and sends seven-minute ones to the family group chat, which everyone answers with a sticker in three seconds

tracks.title: 紫色嗰條
tracks.mood: sheepish, stubborn and finally laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a 34-year-old office worker who spends eight weeks of lunch breaks failing the same purple V3 route at a bouldering wall on the eleventh floor of a Kwun Tong industrial building, until a ten-year-old tops it on her first try and then shows him the heel hook

tracks.title: 八十七蚊
tracks.mood: petty, furious and funny about money
tracks.subject: chasing four friends since March for the eighty-seven dollars each still owed from a birthday karaoke room you paid for

tracks.title: 隔條涌
tracks.subject: a Tai O sampan girl and the shrimp-paste maker on the far bank trading teasing lines across the creek all day, each refusing to be the first to cross, until they agree to meet halfway on the fifty-step bridge

tracks.title: 落水啦
tracks.subject: eight friends on a Saturday junk boat and the one who will not get in the water until someone inflates her giant flamingo

tracks.title: 每月十號
tracks.mood: gloomy, self-mocking and finally a little free
tracks.subject: a two-year gym contract signed on impulse and used four times, and the monthly deduction kept up as proof you still mean to change, until the last one on the tenth of October

tracks.title: 一二扒
tracks.subject: twelve housewives from Shek Kip Mei Estate in a small dragon boat at a district Tuen Ng race against the fire station crew, one heat each and the final still to row

tracks.title: 大閘蟹
tracks.genre: Cantonese opera aria with modern orchestra
tracks.subject: meeting a girlfriend's father for the first time over a hairy crab dinner in a restaurant private room and sending a crab leg flying out of the private-room door

tracks.title: 等埋佢
tracks.subject: a church volunteer driving a seven-seater van round three housing estates every Sunday morning to collect five elderly members, waiting for each of them

tracks.title: 拍拖未呀
tracks.genre: Cantonese Lunar New Year festive pop
tracks.subject: doing the round of eleven relatives' flats on the second day of Lunar New Year and being asked 'are you seeing anyone yet?' at every door, with a different dodge ready for each

tracks.title: 又眨眼
tracks.subject: five friends squeezed into a Mong Kok photo-sticker booth, eight poses in ten seconds a shot, and one of them blinking in every frame

tracks.title: 八號風球
tracks.mood: sudden freedom, running laughing into the rain
tracks.subject: typhoon signal number eight going up at twenty to five and a whole office building emptying at once

tracks.title: 兩隻匙羹
tracks.mood: newly in love, sun-drunk and in no hurry
tracks.subject: sharing one bowl of tofu pudding with two spoons at the Lamma pier with someone you have just started seeing

tracks.title: 準時放工
tracks.subject: five office friends putting ten dollars each on the silliest-named horse at Happy Valley on a Wednesday night and watching it come from last to first

tracks.title: 第十格
tracks.subject: a couple in a Friday-night bowling league in Kowloon Bay where she bowls and he keeps the score sheet and shouts every strike

tracks.title: 前面有落
tracks.mood: a comic standoff that turns into a singalong
tracks.subject: a passenger who calls her minibus stop two traffic lights too late, and all sixteen passengers taking sides

tracks.title: 廿四味
tracks.subject: a herbal tea shop owner who looks at your tongue and tells you exactly how late you stayed up

tracks.title: 三十一、三十二
tracks.subject: a retired schoolteacher on the Sai Kung pier teaching himself to cast from a phone video every Sunday, counting every cast out loud

tracks.title: 打橫行
tracks.subject: being stuck at lunch behind five people walking abreast on a Causeway Bay pavement while the cha chaan teng queue grows

tracks.title: 佔兩個位
tracks.subject: carrying a second-hand Carousell keyboard home across two seats of a 2 a.m. night bus while a drunk passenger asks for a song

tracks.title: 廣場舞
tracks.subject: a grandmother in the second row of thirty women square-dancing at seven in the morning

tracks.title: 天星
tracks.mood: sitting in the seat that faced the other way
tracks.subject: a nine-minute Star Ferry crossing and the flip-back bench seat

tracks.title: 寫揮春
tracks.subject: a father whose hand now shakes asking you to write the new year couplets

tracks.title: 搶飛
tracks.mood: wanting to win one thing as an adult
tracks.subject: three phones, two laptops and a tablet queueing for concert tickets that sell out in twelve minutes

tracks.title: 報稅表
tracks.mood: your year turning out to be a few boxes
tracks.subject: a twenty-five-year-old's first tax return and the hour a mother spends explaining it

tracks.title: 抽居屋
tracks.mood: a rehearsed sentence twelve years in the making
tracks.subject: a mother's fourth failed public housing ballot and the line she has practised

tracks.title: 搭枱
tracks.subject: sharing a table with a stranger at a cha chaan teng

tracks.title: 行山嗰個阿伯
tracks.mood: being noticed by exactly one person
tracks.subject: three years of saying good morning to the same man on the same trail

tracks.title: 雪櫃上面
tracks.mood: counting how many people once thought of you
tracks.subject: nineteen fridge magnets, none of them bought by you

tracks.title: 幫人睇舖
tracks.subject: minding a button shop for two hours and taking fourteen dollars

tracks.title: 指甲鉗
tracks.subject: cutting your eighty-year-old mother's toenails on a low stool

tracks.title: 十四樓冇燈
tracks.mood: quietly surprised by your own building
tracks.subject: fourteen days of stairs while the lift is being repaired

tracks.title: 十二個鏡頭
tracks.subject: a night security guard who turns a camera away from someone crying

tracks.title: 交更
tracks.subject: handing over the keys on the last shift after thirty-one years

tracks.title: 戒咗三次
tracks.subject: quitting vaping for the fourth time and refusing to announce it

tracks.title: 你嗰張凳
tracks.subject: 朋友移民之後張凳冇人坐

tracks.title: 租金同我
tracks.subject: 同業主傾加租

tracks.title: 捱得住
tracks.subject: 連續返咗十一日工

tracks.title: 執笠嗰日落閘
tracks.subject: 樓下士多結業最後一日

tracks.title: 得返呢間房
tracks.subject: 一間劏房入面嘅一次傾偈

tracks.title: 未寄的信
tracks.subject: a letter never posted

tracks.title: 橋底風大
tracks.subject: standing under a flyover in Mong Kok

tracks.title: 彌敦道嘅雨
tracks.subject: rain on Nathan Road

tracks.title: 唔講都知
tracks.subject: what goes unsaid between two people

tracks.title: 深水埗嘅朝早
tracks.subject: morning in Sham Shui Po

tracks.title: 劍未曾出鞘
tracks.subject: a sword never drawn

tracks.title: 浮雲
tracks.subject: clouds from a rooftop

tracks.title: 一個人食飯
tracks.subject: eating alone

tracks.title: 電梯冇停
tracks.subject: a lift that never stops

tracks.title: 行多幾步
tracks.subject: a few more steps
